text: The authors report that how much an agent trusts its own output over others' can be controlled by the debate prompt, and that prompts encouraging agents to be more stubborn led to longer debates and better final solutions. They observed that agents were relatively agreeable, which they suggest may result from instruction tuning or RLHF.
title: Prompts making agents more stubborn give longer debates and better answers
